name: man-db
description: The Man-DB package contains programs for finding and viewing man pages.

installed_descriptions.name: accessdb
installed_descriptions.description: Dumps the whatis database contents in human-readable form

installed_descriptions.name: apropos
installed_descriptions.description: Searches the whatis database and displays the short descriptions of system commands that contain a given string

installed_descriptions.name: catman
installed_descriptions.description: Creates or updates the pre-formatted manual pages

installed_descriptions.name: lexgrog
installed_descriptions.description: Displays one-line summary information about a given manual page

installed_descriptions.name: man
installed_descriptions.description: Formats and displays the requested manual page

installed_descriptions.name: man-recode
installed_descriptions.description: Converts manual pages to another encoding

installed_descriptions.name: mandb
installed_descriptions.description: Creates or updates the whatis database

installed_descriptions.name: manpath
installed_descriptions.description: Displays the contents of $MANPATH or (if $MANPATH is not set) a suitable search path based on the settings in man.conf and the user's environment

installed_descriptions.name: whatis
installed_descriptions.description: Searches the whatis database and displays the short descriptions of system commands that contain the given keyword as a separate word
